actual: Auto-filed CI/Nightly issues such as GitHub Issue #683 can be triaged as infra_flaky/infra_blocker with needs_bug_json=false and infra_action_required_no_code_bug, but ci-issue-janitor only closes superseded_by_later_main_success issues. This leaves infrastructure noise open even after the workflow has enough information to close it without creating BUG JSON. Expected: ci-issue-janitor dry-run/apply should support infra_flaky/infra_blocker auto-filed issues when triage returns needs_bug_json=false and infra_action.workflow_gate=infra_action_required, add a clear close comment with runner/infrastructure next actions, and never promote BUG JSON for these issues. Acceptance: targeted tests cover dry-run and apply for infra issues, existing superseded behavior is unchanged, and Issue #683 can be safely closed as infra without root pollution. Production gates noop.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
